description: Start a fresh StockLens analysis of one company, only when the person asks for one or agrees to an offer of one in a get_market_summary result. A new run may use one Analysis credit, or one Plus Analysis credit when depth is plus; the result says if the person's plan does not include it. Use it for a requested evidence gap beyond the nightly snapshot, such as factor values, peer context or ranked contributors. Both depths include written domain summaries and synthesis when produced; Plus adds deeper synthesis and extra web cards where available. The assistant result is condensed; the saved web report has the factor cards and Explain views. It returns an analysis_id at once and finishes asynchronously; fetch the result with fetch_analysis_result when the person asks for it. new_run_started and reused_existing say whether a recent matching analysis was reused. One ticker per call. It does not rank or compare companies, and does not trade or move money.

analysis_emphasis.description: Optional. RISK_EMPHASIS | BALANCED | FUNDAMENTAL_GROWTH_EMPHASIS. Must agree with the emphasis implied by risk_tolerance (low->RISK_EMPHASIS, medium->BALANCED, high->FUNDAMENTAL_GROWTH_EMPHASIS); a mismatch is rejected as a validation error before any credit is consumed.

depth.description: Analysis depth: standard or plus. Both include written domain summaries and synthesis when produced. Plus uses deeper synthesis and adds extra cards in the web report where available. Standard uses an Analysis credit (LENS_AI); Plus uses a Plus Analysis credit (LENS_AI_PLUS). Default standard.

evidence_history_family.description: Optional. SHORT_HISTORY | MEDIUM_HISTORY | LONG_HISTORY. Must agree with the family implied by time_range (short_2_wk->SHORT_HISTORY, medium_1_mo/medium_2_mo->MEDIUM_HISTORY, long_1_yr/long_2_yr->LONG_HISTORY); a mismatch is rejected as a validation error before any credit is consumed. Does not select a representative range on its own.

exchange.description: Exchange code (e.g. NASDAQ). Optional. Resolved automatically if omitted.

risk_tolerance.description: Analysis focus. It reweights how much the analysis weighs downside/quality risk vs. growth/fundamentals. NOT a personal risk or suitability assessment, and it never changes the company's underlying facts. low=Defensive, medium=Balanced, high=Growth. Default medium.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL). Exactly one ticker per call.

time_range.description: Time horizon. It shapes which signals the analysis weighs most (shorter horizons favor price action, momentum and news; longer favor fundamentals and quality). Not a price forecast. One window per calibrated band: short_2_wk (Short-term), medium_1_mo (Medium-term), long_1_yr (Long-term). Default medium_1_mo. The legacy medium_2_mo and long_2_yr aliases are still accepted and resolve to medium_1_mo and long_1_yr respectively.
